canDoYue: 你識講邊樣跟得上進度、邊次樣辦落後、星期五跟進、寫低問題同行動。
canDoEn: Say what is on track, which sample run is behind, and who will follow up by Friday with a written note.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Most of our design work is fully on track this month, and the morning meeting can stay short.
dialogue.glossYue: 設計工作大部分跟得上進度，朝早個會可以短啲。
dialogue.say: Most of our design work is fully on track this month, and the morning meeting can stay short.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Which part of the monthly plan is behind schedule right now, and who owns that sample run?
dialogue.glossYue: 月計劃邊一部分落後，邊個負責嗰次樣辦？
dialogue.say: Which part of the monthly plan is behind schedule right now, and who owns that sample run?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: The sample run is behind schedule, and I own that part of the monthly plan by myself.
dialogue.glossYue: 樣辦落後咗，呢一部分我自己負責。
dialogue.say: The sample run is behind schedule, and I own that part of the monthly plan by myself.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Can you please follow up by Friday and send me one written note after you speak with the client?
dialogue.glossYue: 你可唔可以星期五之前跟進，同客戶傾完之後寫張字條？
dialogue.say: Can you please follow up by Friday and send me one written note after you speak with the client?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: I will follow up by Friday, and I will send the written note out on that same day.
dialogue.glossYue: 我星期五之前會跟進，字條同一日送出。
dialogue.say: I will follow up by Friday, and I will send the written note out on that same day.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Are there any open questions before we write down each action item for the team?
dialogue.glossYue: 寫低每項行動之前，仲有冇未解嘅問題？
dialogue.say: Are there any open questions before we write down each action item for the team?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: The action item is mine, and I will call the client on Friday with a clear answer.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢項行動我負責，我星期五會打畀客戶講清楚。
dialogue.say: The action item is mine, and I will call the client on Friday with a clear answer.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Please send that written note straight after the meeting so I can read each action item.
dialogue.glossYue: 會後請將張字條送嚟，等我睇每項行動。
dialogue.say: Please send that written note straight after the meeting so I can read each action item.
